budgetRequests.title: Budget requests
budgetRequests.subtitle: Mid-cycle changes (Increase / Decrease / Transfer) to this budget. Approved requests are applied to line items atomically.

form.title: Submit budget request
form.description: Route Increase / Decrease / Transfer through the approval chain. Amount drives which approvers must sign off.

kindHint.INCREASE: Add funds to a specific line item.
kindHint.DECREASE: Release unspent funds from a specific line item.
kindHint.TRANSFER: Move funds between two line items (net-zero to the budget).

form.justificationPlaceholder: Explain why this change is needed (minimum 20 characters).
form.justificationHint: At least 20 characters — helps the approvers review faster.

actions.appliedToast: Budget request applied to line items.
actions.rejectDescription: Provide a short reason. The requester will see this in their notification.
actions.cancelDescription: Withdraw this request. This action cannot be undone.

expenses.subtitle: Project reimbursements flow through the tiered approval matrix (rules §9).

form.needsProject: You need an active project before submitting expenses.

actions.approveDescription: This will advance the expense to the next level in the approval matrix.
actions.rejectDescription: Rejected expenses cannot be re-opened. Provide a clear rationale.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.subtitle: Project budgets per fiscal year. Route to Finance and Director for approval (rules §9.2).

form.title: Create budget
form.description: Header info only. Add line items after the budget is created.
form.needsProject: Create or activate a project before drafting a budget.

lineItems.descriptionPlaceholder: What does this line pay for?

detail.lineItemsSubtitle: Planned vs realized vs outstanding. Remaining is auto-computed.
detail.noLineItems: No line items yet. Add at least one before submitting.

actions.approveDescription: Advances the budget to the next approver (or finalizes it if no further slot).
actions.rejectDescription: Sends the budget back to CANCELLED with your reason recorded in the audit trail.
actions.cancelDescription: Only the submitter (or ADMIN) can cancel a budget while it's still open.
actions.commentPlaceholder: Add context for the next approver…

form.chainPreviewEmpty: Enter an amount to preview approvers.

detail.netRefund: Employee to refund the difference back to company cash.

actions.approveDescription: This will advance to the next level in the approval chain.

types.generalHint: Any project member may request. Approval: PM (≥ IDR 2M) → Finance → Director (≥ IDR 20M).
types.fieldOpsHint: Supervisor-initiated for field visits. Approval always starts at Supervisor; escalates to PM / OM / Director based on amount.

pettyCash.title: Petty cash

fundForm.openingBalanceHint: Defaults to imprest if left blank

voucherForm.title: New petty cash voucher
voucherForm.description: Record a spend against the fund. Max Rp 999.999.

replenishment.description: Ask Lead Finance to top up the fund back to the imprest ceiling.

actions.approveDescription: This will unlock disbursement by Lead Finance.

secrets.title: Infrastructure Secret Rotation
secrets.description: Every long-lived secret must rotate on a 90-day cadence (rules §22). This page tracks `last_rotated_at` per credential and flags OVERDUE when the window closes. Cron `/api/cron/rotation-check` runs every Monday morning (WIB).

actions.markRotatedDescription: This sets `last_rotated_at = now()` and records you as `last_rotated_by`. Only do this after the new credential is live in every environment.
actions.notesPlaceholder: e.g. ticket number, maintenance window, buddy engineer

archives.title: Cold-Storage Archives
archives.description: Registry of gzip'd NDJSON archives held in the `tenant-archives` bucket. Financial data has a 10-year retention (rules §22); after 2 years it is exported to cold storage. Source rows are only purged after a successful checksum verification.
archives.empty: No batches archived yet. The `/api/cron/archive` job runs weekly on Sunday night (UTC).

actions.downloadStarted: Signed URL opened. Expires in 5 min.
